content:
Apple TV is currently airing the highly anticipated fourth season of "Ted Lasso," which has been a resounding success, but three more exciting new titles will be available soon.

First: "Dark Matter"

Apple TV has plenty of fantastic offerings for sci-fi fans. Beyond well-known hits like "Severance" and "Pluribus," "Dark Matter" may be a hidden gem that you have overlooked.

The series is adapted from Blake Crouch's bestselling novel and stars Joel Edgerton and Jennifer Connelly.

Season 2 of "Dark Matter" will premiere on Friday, August 28, with new episodes released weekly through October 30.

Here is the synopsis provided by Apple:

Second: "Mayday"

Apple TV has a slate of new films lined up for this autumn, most of which will debut on the streaming platform rather than receiving a theatrical release.

Kicking things off is "Mayday," an action comedy starring Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh, which reimagines classic spy thrillers.

"Mayday" will be available exclusively on Apple TV starting Friday, September 4.

Here is the plot synopsis and trailer provided by Apple:

Third: "Slow Horses"

One of Apple's most acclaimed series, "Slow Horses," is set to return.

In the streaming era, audiences often have to wait several years for a new season of their favourite shows. But "Slow Horses" maintains its tradition of returning annually, with Gary Oldman as Jackson Lamb leading the team in more gripping spy stories.

Season 6 of "Slow Horses" will premiere on Wednesday, September 16, with new episodes released weekly through October 21.

Apple TV subscription costs US$12.99 per month, and bundle discounts are available through Apple One.
